svg.title: Gestion des projets — C4 component view of the backend
svg.desc: C4 component diagram of the backend: requests from the nginx frontend reach four REST controllers, each calling its service and its Spring Data repository on MySQL; the team and project-detail services also read other domains' repositories. Micrometer keeps the metrics that Actuator exposes at /actuator/prometheus for Prometheus; Actuator's readiness group includes the database.
